name: Donchian Channel Breakout
description: Volatility breakout strategy based on Turtle Trading methodology. Enters long when price breaks above N-period high, exits on opposite signal. Adapted from TradingView/CoinQuant research showing best risk-adjusted returns in crypto.
author: Jarvis - External Research (CoinQuant/TradingView)

entry_rules.long: Price closes above the N-period Donchian upper band (highest high of last N periods)
entry_rules.short: Price closes below the N-period Donchian lower band (lowest low of last N periods)

exit_rules.long: Price closes below the N-period Donchian lower band
exit_rules.short: Price closes above the N-period Donchian upper band

channel_period.description: Lookback period for Donchian channel calculation

risk_per_trade.description: Risk per trade as fraction of equity

research_notes.key_insight: Accept many small losses, let few big winners pay for everything. Best risk-adjusted performance of three tested strategies.
research_notes.risk_profile: Medium - requires psychological discipline due to low win rate
